title: Ali Asghar Ali Asghar
body:
ali ashger ali asgher
meri jaan aye mere dilbar
na barsa paani kyu'n ya rab
zabaa'n hoton pe pheri jab
<<DIVIDER>>
adu bhi ro pade the tab
sitam tujh per huwa kaisa
ewaz paani ke aye beta
chhida nanha gala tera
<<DIVIDER>>
aye tashnalab mere bache
huwe ho qatl tum pyaase
tumhari maa jiye kaise
ali asgher ki chahat me
<<DIVIDER>>
likha sughra ne hasrat me
jiya jaayena furqat me
the kaise sang dil aada
di baade marg bhi eeza
<<DIVIDER>>
nikala qabr se laasha
καηα βανο νε αυε beta
tha sin kul chhe mahine ka
chadha naize par sar tera
<<DIVIDER>>
fasih ab kar dua paiham
teri turbat pe aaye ham
wahi'n nikle hamara dam
